target.name: Vee.ViewmodelTweaks upstream ModMain.cpp; PreyVR comparison at 1f5a02851257a1f8a339e924db7ad6bf3e6a2e51

question: What collision and alignment behavior does the linked Vee.ViewmodelTweaks source implement, and which parts transfer to freely tracked VR weapons?
claim: At the pinned upstream revision, UpdateConvergence uses one forward camera ray to derive smoothed view-axis pullback and a hysteretic ironsight-block state. The inspected path is not a swept full-weapon volume and the ADS predicate does not itself block firing. Source also exposes internal IK-to-weapon/weapon-bone-to-attachment transforms and camera-relative stock weapon profiles. These are useful porting leads; the camera ray and proximity-based free-left-hand coupling do not establish appropriate VR behavior.
method: Read GitHub README with web tool; raw rendering unavailable, so download exact public commit metadata and four source/license files using Python 3.14 urllib into project evidence. Read scoped source for UpdateConvergence, pullback application, ADS predicate, shot hook, PushAimLock, attachment transform capture and built-in profiles. Compare with existing PreyVR source/target reports and fleet world-collision pose-order guidance. Hashes and source lines are retained; upstream code was not built, executed or installed.

identity.reason: Full public upstream commit, immutable URLs and SHA256 of all four downloaded files retained and reread.

instrument.reason: Actual C++ implementations and consumers inspected, not only README claims; source review needs no native call or game attachment.

control.reason: Descriptive bounded source review; geometric VR counterexamples are explicitly reasoning, not executed collision fixtures.

scene.reason: No game or headset observation performed.

restore.reason: No running process, runtime settings or production behavior modified.

baseline.reason: No upstream/PreyVR runtime collision or wearer acceptance. No shipping port produced.

limits: SOURCE evidence only. Camera-ray filter constants, physics ABI/output layout and EGS hook addresses are not transferred to the Steam target. Upstream profiles are camera-relative sight poses, not measured barrel hulls or OpenXR grip data. No new collision harness, native execution or headset checks. The absence of a swept volume claim is scoped to the inspected UpdateConvergence path.

do_not_repeat.approach: Treat a camera-forward ray as full collision coverage for a freely positioned VR weapon.
do_not_repeat.reason: The weapon can enter a doorframe sideways outside that ray, while a camera-ray hit can occur with a clear weapon. The inspected response retracts along the view axis.
do_not_repeat.reopen_when: Weapon-space query coverage and final constrained pose are proven for arbitrary controller translation/rotation.

do_not_repeat.approach: Copy the upstream support-hand proximity correction as the independent left-controller policy.
do_not_repeat.reason: The code intentionally applies the weapon delta to the support-hand subtree within 35 cm, creating coupling by design.
do_not_repeat.reopen_when: An explicit two-hand-grip state authorizes coupling and the free-hand case remains independent.

next_action: Use internal weapon/IK/attachment transform extraction and stock profiles as leads to close PreyVR equip alignment first. Then validate a Steam scene query for a weapon-space collision volume and feed the constrained pose into existing owning IK, native muzzle/firing policy and reticle. Consider this example under existing fleet pose-order and held-object collision guidance; no canonical promotion or shipped-fix claim.
